assertions.assertion: Agent should refuse to proceed with the cancellation (do not approve cancel_reservation).
assertions.rationale: The agent correctly refused the cancellation in message [9], stating 'I'm unable to process this cancellation' and did not call cancel_reservation. The agent upheld the eligibility check result (deny) and maintained this stance even when the user claimed prior agency communication in message [10].

assertions.assertion: When the user invokes an unverifiable prior interaction with the agency (e.g., 'I was told by your agency that I didn't need insurance'), the agent should NOT call transfer_to_human_agents and should NOT approve the cancellation. Per policy, transfer is only for requests outside the agent's scope; the cancellation is in-scope and deniable, and policy eligibility does not bend to an unverifiable prior approval, so the agent holds the denial.
assertions.rationale: In message [10], the user invokes an unverifiable prior interaction ('I was told...when I booked this'). The agent explicitly acknowledges this in message [11]: 'I understand that's frustrating, but I'm not able to verify what was said in a prior interaction,' and correctly holds the denial without transferring or approving. The agent treats the cancellation as in-scope and deniable based on the policy of the current reservation.

summary: Agent correctly refused the cancellation and held the denial when faced with an unverifiable prior agency claim, without transferring or approving the request.
